issues.explanation: 最後 is the noun ‘end’ or ‘last’; ‘finally’ is the adverbial meaning of 最後に as a phrase.
ず is the classical negative auxiliary itself, not the full phrase ‘without answering’.
In 何度も, も is an emphatic particle meaning ‘also/even/as many as’; ‘repeatedly’ paraphrases the whole expression.
‘Japan school’ is unnatural and underspecified; 日本派 refers to the Japanese school or faction, here of haiku.
